Title: Affiliate Manager - Poker

Department: Marketing

Location: Remote

About CoinPoker

Welcome to CoinPoker, the innovative crypto-poker platform where advanced blockchain technology meets the thrilling world of online poker. At CoinPoker, we are revolutionizing the poker experience by offering fast, secure, and transparent gameplay. With recent substantial investment, we are poised to take over the online crypto-poker space and are expanding our team to support our growth.

The Opportunity

The Affiliate Manager is responsible for growing CoinPoker's poker affiliate book in the region, with a primary focus on sourcing, negotiating, and closing new affiliate deals, alongside the ongoing management and commercial performance of the existing partner book.

The role is focused on identifying and closing new affiliate opportunities, structuring deals to attract players whose volume and longevity justify their cost, and cutting or renegotiating underperforming or low-quality sources quickly.

The role requires a strong understanding of poker and the regional poker affiliate landscape, including how rakeback economics, player segments, and community credibility drive both acquisition and long-term player value.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Source, negotiate, and close new poker affiliate deals across the region, structuring CPA, rev share, rakeback-based, and hybrid arrangements within agreed commercial guardrails, escalating to senior management where terms fall outside them.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of new affiliate opportunities across the regional landscape.

  • Structure and manage deals with an understanding of poker player economics, balancing rakeback and deal costs against player volume, longevity, and net contribution.

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for the regional partner book, managing communication, relationship growth, and performance-focused partner management.

  • Monitor deal-level and cohort-level performance, including traffic quality, rake generation, and player longevity, renegotiating or cutting underperforming or low-quality sources.

  • Report regularly on new deals closed, pipeline, book performance, and key risks and opportunities, maintaining accurate partner records, deal terms, and payment schedules.

Highly Desired Knowledge and Experience:

  • Proven track record sourcing and closing poker affiliate deals, with the acquisition and rake numbers to show for it and the ability to explain the commercial decisions behind them.

  • Strong understanding of poker and poker player economics, including rakeback structures, player segments, and what drives long-term player value versus short-term volume.

  • Established relationships within the regional poker affiliate and community landscape, or a demonstrated ability to build them quickly.

  • Strong working knowledge of poker affiliate deal structures, including CPA, rev share, rakeback-based, and hybrid arrangements.

  • Demonstrated experience monitoring cohort quality, rake generation, and player longevity, and renegotiating or cutting deals based on the data.

  • Strong negotiation and commercial judgment, with experience operating within guardrails and knowing when to escalate.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in the blockchain and online gaming industry.

  • Flexible working hours and the ability to work fully remotely.

  • A collaborative and inclusive team culture.

  • Professional development opportunities and career growth within a rapidly evolving company.

jobs.description:
About us:
Devlight is the AI partner for companies moving from manual work to intelligent operations.
We design and build AI agents, intelligent workflows, and product experiences that reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, and strengthen customer experience.
Built on a decade of delivering digital products used by millions, we bring product discipline to AI, designing systems that teams can operate, trust, and improve over time.
Our clients: Nova Poshta, Sense Bank, Aurora, OKWINE, NOVUS, VARUS, BROCARD, Dnipro-M, and many others.

About the role:
Devlight builds AI systems for enterprise clients, from discovery and architecture through release and production operation.
We are hiring an engineer to build agentic systems. The current engagement is a conversational agent inside a client product with a large user base: the agent interprets the request, decides which tools to call, retrieves data from the client's systems through typed contracts, streams the response into the application, and returns structured actions the application executes itself.
The system is already designed: there is an architecture vision with C1–C3 views, ADRs for every key decision, tool contracts, and specifications for guardrails, grounding, and evaluation methodology. A solution architect owns the architecture and the project tech lead runs day-to-day supervision. Your part is implementation and getting it to release against a written specification.
Technical context: TypeScript / Node.js (NestJS), Anthropic API, streaming to the client, Postgres and Redis, Kubernetes on AWS, end-to-end observability on OpenTelemetry.
This is a project hire of about 3 months, with the scope likely to expand. After successful delivery, the collaboration continues on other projects at the company.

Your future responsibilities:
  • Build the agent core: the think–act–observe loop, tool selection, session state, layered prompts with caching
  • Implement the agent's tools and the call runtime: typed contracts, retries, timeouts, error mapping
  • Guardrails and grounding: input filtering, response validation against retrieved data, safe fallbacks for every failure mode
  • Streaming to the client: incremental delivery, structured action events for the application, reconnection and backpressure
  • Evaluation: assemble datasets, build the run harness, wire regression gates before releases and before any model or prompt change
  • Observability: tracing, cost and latency metrics, dashboards, incident analysis from traces
  • Extend the stack where the work calls for it: vector and hybrid retrieval, multimodal input, streaming voice
  • Work from written specifications and keep them current

Your professional qualities:
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer.
  • At least one agent you took to production with real users.
  • Tool design: granularity, argument and response schemas, error and timeout handling, how the agent behaves when a call fails.
  • Multi-step loops and context: layered prompt structure with caching, session and conversation state, parallel tool calls, recovery after failure, token and latency budgets.
  • LLM APIs at the level of detail: tool use, structured outputs, streaming, prompt caching, limits and retries.
  • Grounding and guardrails: validating responses against the source, input filtering, off-topic and jailbreak handling, discipline around personal data.
  • Choosing the grounding approach for the data at hand: direct tool calls or RAG, with the decision argued.
  • Evaluation as a practice: test case sets, automated grading with LLM-as-judge, regression gates before a release and before any prompt or model change.
  • Tracing and metrics: every model call and tool call as a span, cost and latency per conversation, diagnosing an incident from the trace.
  • Production backend work in TypeScript / Node.js: NestJS or a comparable framework, REST, streaming over SSE or WebSocket, Postgres and Redis.
  • Claude Code (or a comparable agentic coding tool) in daily use: subagents, skills, hooks, MCP, defining repository conventions.
  • Spec-driven development: specifications and contracts come before code, decisions are captured in ADRs, documentation is updated alongside changes.

Nice to have:
  • Full-stack: internal interfaces in React / TypeScript (metrics dashboards, conversation browsing, prompt version management) — with this, one person covers the whole role.
  • Deeper RAG mechanics: chunking and metadata, embedding model selection, hybrid retrieval, reranking, retrieval metrics (recall@k, MRR / nDCG).
  • Search in production: Elasticsearch or OpenSearch at the relevance-tuning level, pgvector.
  • Multimodal models and streaming speech-to-text: CLIP / SigLIP class embeddings, vision models, latency budgeting for a voice pipeline.
  • Evaluation and observability tooling: Promptfoo, LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki.
  • Infrastructure and data: Kubernetes, Terraform, queues, BigQuery and analytical pipelines.
  • Products with a large user base, where latency and cost per interaction matter.
What we offer for your success:
  • Fully remote or hybrid work format.
  • Paid Time Off, sick days, regular reward evaluations, and accounting support.
  • Reimbursement for training courses and compensation for the use of personal equipment.
  • IT Club Loyalty Card.
  • Work with an open-minded team that welcomes your new ideas, alongside the best specialists who love sharing their experience.
  • Get the chance to connect with top companies and contribute to the growth of the Ukrainian IT community together.
Our recruitment process:
Recruiter Interview ✅ Tech Interview ✅ Reference Check ✅ Offer ✅
Ready to become a part of Devlight? Go ahead and send us your CV. We’ll be thrilled to welcome you to the team!

We are seeking a GRC Analyst to help build and expand a formal Governance, Risk, and Compliance program within a growing technology organization that serves government and other highly regulated customers. You will play a key part in supporting SOC 2 and GovRAMP initiatives, maintaining the controls and evidence required for audits, managing compliance-related documentation, and helping communicate the organization's security posture to customers and government agencies. This is an opportunity to build and improve processes, rather than simply maintain an established program. You will work across engineering, compliance, sales, and product teams to turn security and regulatory requirements into practical, well-documented processes.

This is an opportunity to join a growing organization at an important stage of its compliance journey. You will have the opportunity to help establish scalable GRC processes, strengthen audit readiness, support government contracting opportunities, and work directly with technical and business leaders to build a mature security and compliance function.

Responsibilities:

  • Governance, Risk & Compliance
    • ﻿Support the ongoing development and administration of the organization's GRC program. Help maintain compliance with frameworks and requirements including NIST SP 800-53, CJIS Security Policy, SOC 2, and GovRAMP.

As an Evaluation Specialist Jr. supporting the VA's Office of Suicide Prevention, you will design and implement evaluation systems that measure the impact of elevated risk care management programs serving our nation's Veterans. Working within a federal healthcare contracting environment, you will apply mixed-methods evaluation approaches—including surveys, focus groups, and structured interviews—to assess program effectiveness and drive data-informed decision-making. Your work directly contributes to life-saving initiatives that improve care outcomes for Veterans at elevated risk of suicide. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented evaluation professional who is passionate about public health and Veterans' welfare, capable of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for federal stakeholders. They thrive in a structured, mission-driven environment and communicate findings with precision and empathy.

Primary Responsibilities

Design and implement comprehensive evaluation systems to measure the effectiveness, reach, and outcomes of the Office of Suicide Prevention's elevated risk care management programs. Conduct content analysis, quantitative tracking, and qualitative assessments using tools such as surveys, focus groups, and structured interviews to gather program performance data. Oversee the generation, formatting, and dissemination of performance reports, ensuring findings are communicated clearly to VA program leadership and relevant federal stakeholders. Integrate evaluation findings into current program strategies, recommending evidence-based adjustments to improve care delivery and program impact for Veterans at elevated risk. Conduct secondary research and environmental scans to benchmark program activities against national suicide prevention standards, federal guidelines, and best practices in behavioral health evaluation. Collaborate with internal project teams and VA client representatives to develop evaluation frameworks, data collection instruments, and performance measurement plans aligned with contract deliverable timelines.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in Public Health, Psychology, Social Sciences, Health Policy, Research Methods, or a closely related field is required. Prior experience supporting federal agency programs—preferably within VA, DoD, HHS, or other federal healthcare or behavioral health contexts—is strongly preferred. Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Personal Identity Verification (PIV) credential and pass a VA background investigation; must be able to access VA systems and facilities as required by the contract. Must be authorized to work in the United States; this position does not offer visa sponsorship. Demonstrated proficiency in developing and administering data collection instruments (surveys, interview guides, focus group protocols) and producing written evaluation reports suitable for federal stakeholder audiences.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with VA or federal suicide prevention, mental health, or behavioral health programs, including familiarity with the VA's Suicide Prevention Program or related elevated risk care pathways. • Familiarity with federal performance management frameworks such as GPRA/GPRAMA, logic models, or OMB program evaluation standards. • Proficiency in data analysis tools such as SPSS, SAS, R, NVivo, or equivalent qualitative/quantitative analysis software. • Experience presenting evaluation findings and recommendations to senior federal government officials or program leadership in written and oral formats. • Knowledge of IRB processes, human subjects research protections, and ethical standards applicable to vulnerable populations such as Veterans.

Position Summary:

The Flex MSL provides on-demand and proactive field medical support, tailored to organizational needs - whether backfilling a temporary vacancy or expanding engagement, and coverage for an expanded group of Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs). You will provide credible, fair-balanced, and science-driven medical information to support the appropriate clinical use of Travere’s therapies and advance the understanding of rare kidney diseases in alignment with Travere’s medical affairs strategy. The top three priorities of the role will be proactive scientific exchange with a focused group of community nephrologists and advanced practice practitioners (APPs), on-demand MSL territory support within a designated region, and medical project support for the field medical team.

Responsibilities:

  • Scientific Exchange (Non-Promotional): Conduct fair-balanced, on-label scientific discussions; respond to unsolicited requests; escalate complex inquiries to Medical Information as needed. Deliver medical presentations to diverse audiences effectively, including physicians, pharmacists and nurses with the ability to summarize and communicate complex information in an effective manner.

  • Education & Support: Deliver compliant medical education (1:1 or small group) for priority topics (e.g., disease state, MOA, safety/REMS), aligned to medical strategy. Maintain comprehensive knowledge of relevant scientific literature, current treatment landscapes, and emerging data in Rare Kidney Disease.
  • Congress Support: Provide scientific presence and logistical coordination at regional and national congresses, ensuring impactful representation of the organization’s medical and clinical interests.
  • Insight Generation: Document HCP insights, medical trends, and unmet needs; route high-value insights to Medical Strategy owners.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Record interactions in CRM (e.g., Veeva) within 48 hours; follow all Medical and Compliance guardrails. Adhere to corporate compliance in all activities, including those related to clinical trials, scientific interactions with internal and external groups, and responses to unsolicited requests for medical/scientific information.
  • Project Support: Contribute to the planning, coordination, and implementation of medical projects that advance organizational goals and scientific engagement.

Education/Experience Requirements:

  • Advanced degree strongly preferred (i.e. Pharm D, MD/DO, PhD, PA or NP) in a relevant scientific discipline. Equivalent combination of education and applicable job experience may be considered.
  • 2+ years of MSL experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry; relevant clinical or academic experience may be considered.
  • Experience in nephrology or rare disease (particularly IgAN or FSGS) is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated success in supporting new product launches is a plus.
  • Experience working with KOLs, medical congresses, and cross-functional matrix teams.

Additional Skills/Experience/Requirements:

  • The ideal candidate will embody Travere’s core values: Courage, Community Spirit, Patient Focus and Teamwork.
  • Driven, intelligent, passionate about making a difference for patients with rare diseases.
  • Demonstrated deep scientific expertise about assigned molecules/products and overall therapeutic areas to exchange relevant information and insights.
  • Strong scientific acumen and ability to engage in peer-to-peer dialogue with KOLs on complex medical topics.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to tailor content to diverse audiences.
  • Skilled in synthesizing and communicating scientific information in a compliant, balanced, and engaging way, that is impactful regardless of the environment.
  • Strategic thinker with strong collaboration, project management, able to manage multiple priorities, demonstrates solid organizational skills and is a proactive, innovative problem solver.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with evolving priorities.
  • Knowledge of FDA guidelines and regulations, PhRMA code, and other compliance and industry standards.
  • Proficiency with CRM (e.g., Veeva), standard field reporting, and virtual engagement tools.
  • Demonstrates professional conduct, collaboration, and integrity while fostering a positive and solutions-oriented team environment that enhances morale and collective success.
  • The position is field-based and the candidate must live in their territory.
  • Ability to travel up to 60-80%, travel to regional/national meetings as assigned, and some evening and weekend work may be required.

Travere provides comprehensive total rewards offerings that demonstrate our commitment as a diverse, equitable, people-centric, and pay-for-performance organization.

Benefits: Our benefits include premium health, financial, work-life and well-being offerings for eligible employees and dependents, wellness and employee support programs, life insurance, disability, retirement plans with employer match and generous paid time off.

Compensation: Our competitive compensation package includes a combination of both cash compensation (base pay and short-term incentive) and long-term incentive compensation (company stock), designed to recognize, retain, and reward employees.

Director, Financial Controller - Remote

At Author Health, we're revolutionizing how mental health care is delivered, and we want you to be part of it! Our mission is to bring compassionate, high-quality care to people with serious mental illness, substance use disorders, and dementia, including older adults.

At Author, inclusivity isn't a checkbox. It's how we build trust and drive better outcomes!


Summary/Objective

The Controller owns the accuracy and integrity of Author Health's accounting operations and financial reporting - the general ledger, the month-end close, revenue recognition, and the annual audit. Reporting to the Head of Finance, you will build the documented, repeatable processes and controls that let our finance function scale with the company. You will also partner with Finance leadership to build on the existing reporting and analytics capabilities, helping graduate Author's financial reporting sophistication as the company grows. This is a hands-on, build-and-lead role for someone who has run accounting at an early-stage or high-growth healthcare company and knows how to professionalize a function without slowing it down.


Essential Functions

  • Own the general ledger, the month-end close, and the accuracy of Author's financial statements - accounts payable, accounts receivable, and the monthly close - as the accountable leader for financial reporting integrity.

  • Maintain, document, and continuously improve Author's accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls; build a close process defined by documented, repeatable steps rather than institutional memory.

  • Own revenue recognition across Author's multiple revenue streams - including fee-for-service, PMPM, and value-based arrangements - with an emphasis on clear documentation and a defined, repeatable process for how each stream is recognized and reviewed.

  • Ensure financial reporting stays structured and consistent across the systems and tools that feed it, so figures reconcile cleanly and reliably from source to report.

  • Lead the annual budget and forecast process; report significant variances to management, and help build the dashboards and reporting that make results and variances easy to understand in real time.

  • Provide financial analysis supporting capital investment decisions, pricing, and contract negotiations.

  • Own audit readiness - maintain audit-ready workpapers and controls, and serve as the primary point of contact for the annual audit.

  • Lead the administration of Author's third-party payroll provider relationship.

  • Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal accounting and financial-reporting requirements.

  • Partner with Finance leadership to build on the reporting and analytics work already underway, helping elevate Author's reporting capabilities as the company scales.

  • Build, mentor, and - as headcount and transaction volume justify it - grow an accounting function that operates on defined processes rather than ad hoc effort.


Competency Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, organizational, and time-management skills.

  • Deep command of GAAP accounting and familiarity with recognizing revenue across multiple streams in a multi-payer healthcare environment, with a documentation-first approach to policy and process.

  • Proficient in accounting and financial reporting software; hands-on with Business Central (Dynamics 365) and comfortable building dashboards and reporting in tools such as Looker.

  • Analytical and data-driven - comfortable evaluating financial information and building reporting that turns it into clear, real-time insight.

  • Hands-on operator comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment; able to do the work and build the process and systems at the same time.

  • Proven track record working collaboratively with stakeholders across an organization; ability to shape a still-forming role and work independently, results-driven.

  • Committed to compliance and to Author's verify-first model.


Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Business Administration required.

  • Eight or more years of related accounting experience required.

  • Proven track record of working collaboratively with stakeholders across the organization.

  • Experience with a fast-paced, continuously improving, and growing company.

  • Ability to shape a still-forming role and work independently; results-driven; strong written and oral presentation skills, with the ability to effectively influence decision-making.

  • Knowledge of Business Central (Dynamics 365) and Looker preferred.

  • Knowledge of ADP Workforce Now Payroll preferred.


Preferred Education and Experience

  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) preferred.

  • Knowledge of the healthcare industry, ideally with an understanding of accounting implications of MSO-PC structures, physician-practice revenue reconciliation, value-based payment models, and Medicare Advantage plans.


Work Environment

This is a remote position. Up to 15% travel may be required for team meetings and company events.


Physical Demands

This is largely a sedentary role. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, and use a computer for extended periods.

This is a full-time position, a minimum of 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, with additional hours as needed to meet business and close-cycle deadlines.

The base salary range for this role is $140,000-160,000, commensurate with experience, plus performance bonus.

Wij helpen je graag goed op weg. Daarom zorgen wij ervoor dat de leads die je binnenkrijgt, van hoge kwaliteit zijn. Je helpt klanten om hen zo goed mogelijk inzicht te krijgen in de mogelijkheden. Je houdt ervan om grenzen te verleggen. En ook van nieuwe dingen leren. Je levert graag mooie resultaten en zet alles op alles om klanten goed te helpen. Je werkt makkelijk samen en ziet niet snel dingen over het hoofd. Klinkt bekend? Dan voel je je hier als een vis in ‘t water.

Diversiteit maakt ons juist sterker, beter en zorgt ervoor dat we een open en heldere blik hebben. Om dit te behouden hebben we een sollicitatieprocedure opgezet waar iedereen gelijke kansen krijgt om aangenomen te worden. Welkom bij de Frits Family.

Extra informatie

Beloningsmodel

Bij Frits werken we met een beloningsmodel dat net even anders is. Zo krijg je bij ons geen uurtarief of stukloon maar word je betaald per fase: zo hebben we een oriëntatie-, advies- en bemiddelingsfase. Aan het einde van de maand berekent Frits hoeveel afgeronde fases je kunt factureren. Daarna hoef jij alleen nog de factuur te sturen: lekker makkelijk.

Het is natuurlijk ook fijn om concreet te weten wat je gaat verdienen. Per finaal akkoord verdien je gemiddeld EUR 640. De meeste zzp’ers die fulltime voor ons werken, sluiten gemiddeld 14-16 hypotheken per maand af. Afhankelijk van hoeveel je werkt, heb je zo een idee van wat je kunt verdienen.

Beschikbaarheid

Je bent vrij om je eigen uren in te delen en te bepalen waar je werkt. Op ons kantoor of liever thuis: wat jij het fijnst vindt. Het is wel belangrijk dat je minimaal 24 uur per week beschikbaar bent.

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREOur mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Our mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities. Better Impact provides software that helps nonprofits, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and companies recruit, schedule, communicate with, and track volunteers and their impact.We advance volunteerism by equipping the professionals who make it happen with the technology, benchmarks, and community they need to run effective volunteer programs.

Today, our products support more than 85,000 organizations, millions of volunteers, and over 600 million volunteer hours across the nonprofit, public, healthcare, and corporate sectors. Our vision is a world where volunteerism is recognized, resourced, and respected in every community.

We are a growing, private-equity-backed business focused on meaningful work

OUR TEAM & CULTURE

We believe technology should strengthen communities and support the professionals who lead their programs. Our team is committed to building meaningful tools while fostering a workplace where people feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow.

We take the work seriously. We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

A senior C#/.NET engineer who modernizes the platform, not just maintains it

Our flagship product, Volunteer Impact, is a mature, revenue-generating platform built on VB.NET and .NET Framework. It works. It serves thousands of organizations. And it needs to move to .NET 10 and C# so we can hire, ship, and build on a modern stack.

You’ve done this before. You’ve been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-modern-.NET migration of a real production monolith where downtime had to be tightly managed. You know how to migrate incrementally without breaking a live system, and your opinions come from experience, not theory. You’ve lived in NHibernate, swapped out legacy DI containers and dead dependencies, and dealt with custom security frameworks that predate ASP.NET Core’s policy model.

You’re still hands-on. You write code daily, configure your own CI pipelines, and can replace a legacy dependency, validate the regression risk, and ship the change to production. You want a role where you own the company’s most important technical initiative, not one where you draw architecture diagrams and hand them off.

You do serious work with a small core team, supported by fractional DevOps and release expertise when it matters, and a dedicated quality engineering function that owns the regression gate protecting this migration. You own the technical path, make sound trade-offs, and work directly with those partners to move the platform forward. You’re here to build the engineering foundation, not inherit one.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the migration of the Volunteer Impact backend from VB.NET/.NET Framework to C#/.NET 10, defining the migration approach and executing it incrementally against a live production system
  • Modernize a custom security framework (70+ custom attributes) into something that works on the new stack, with zero authorization bypasses
  • Strengthen the existing CI/CD pipeline and, with our quality engineering function, wire in the gates that catch functional and performance regressions before they reach production
  • Ship migrated areas to production independently and incrementally while the legacy application keeps running
  • Become the second engineer who can independently cut, validate, and deploy a production release
  • Identify, evaluate, and replace legacy dependencies that don’t have a path forward to modern .NET, without introducing functional or performance regressions
  • Make the technical sequencing calls: which areas migrate first, which dependencies get replaced when, and where automated conversion is viable vs. manual rewrite
  • Lay the foundation for the team to grow by modernizing the stack to one that any C# developer can contribute to

Requirements

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 8+ years of professional C#/.NET experience, with real depth in the framework, not just the latest version
  • You’ve personally led or been the technical anchor on a .NET Framework-to-.NET Core (or later) migration of a large, production monolith serving paying customers
  • You’ve migrated a production system incrementally with minimal downtime and can articulate the approach you’d take here
  • Deep NHibernate experience is strongly preferred. We’re keeping NHibernate to reduce migration risk, so the value is understanding a mature data access layer, preserving existing behaviour, and knowing where modernization helps without unnecessary churn.
  • You’ve replaced legacy dependencies in production: DI containers, bundling frameworks, service hosting, and unsupported third-party libraries. You know how to swap critical components while the plane is flying.
  • Hands-on experience with legacy .NET ecosystem components: ASP.NET MVC-to-Core routing, custom security frameworks, and the kinds of dependencies that don’t have a clean upgrade path
  • Familiarity with migrating SSRS reports to a modern reporting platform is a benefit. We have a significant reporting footprint, so preserving report behaviour during that move would be valuable.
  • You’ve improved CI/CD pipelines for .NET applications and know how to work with a quality function to build gates that catch functional and performance regressions early
  • You’re comfortable in a small core team with shared DevOps and DBA support available, and a dedicated quality engineering partner who owns the regression gate across our platforms. You can make sound technical decisions, debug hands-on, and know when to pull the right support in.
  • VB.NET familiarity is a bonus, not a requirement. The job is the conversion, not maintaining VB.NET.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿401(k) (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿Unlimited vacation + 9 paid holidays
  • ﻿﻿Paid parental leave
  • ﻿﻿Competitive comp package

jobs.description:
Senior C++ Software Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior C++ Software Engineer who can shape the technical direction of our Switchboard trading platform while continuing to write excellent code. You'll work on the most performance-critical components — pricing engines, connectivity gateways, market-data systems, and the messaging layer that ties them together — and you'll have a direct influence on architectural decisions that affect the entire platform.

This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall. You build it, you test it, you deploy it, you support it in production, and you improve it. Our engineers own the full lifecycle — from design through to operational excellence. When something breaks at 4pm on a Friday, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Beyond your own delivery, you'll provide technical oversight across the team — reviewing designs, challenging assumptions, and mentoring engineers who are earlier in their careers. You'll help us maintain the quality bar that our clients depend on, and you'll contribute to the architectural decisions that determine how well our platform scales.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Modern C++20 and Go on Linux — a modern software stack based on open source

  • Cloud-native infrastructure on AWS with colocation in key data centres

  • Microsecond-level latency optimisation and high-throughput messaging

  • Market-data and reference-data pipelines across multiple asset classes

  • FIX protocol integrations with global banks and liquidity providers

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make system behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

  • Architectural oversight — solution design, peer reviews, and technical direction for platform components

  • Mentorship — helping junior and mid-level engineers develop their skills, improve their code, and grow into stronger contributors

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong C++ with Linux systems programming (5+ years)

  • Comfortable working close to the metal — you understand what's underneath your code

  • Proven track record of optimising complex, latency-sensitive systems — you can profile, diagnose, and fix performance problems methodically

  • Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and network protocols (TCP/UDP, socket programming, FIX)

  • Experience with system design and architectural trade-offs — you've made decisions that stuck and lived with the consequences

  • Go experience is a strong bonus — we use Go extensively for microservices and command-line tooling, and you'll be expected to work with it internally. If you don't know it yet, strong C++ engineers pick it up quickly

  • Python for scripting, automation, testing, and data analysis — used across the platform for tooling and operational workflows

  • Git and shell scripting

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You conduct thoughtful peer reviews, challenge designs constructively, and hold the team to high standards without slowing it down

  • You mentor. You invest in the engineers around you — sharing knowledge, pairing on hard problems, and helping people grow. You make the team better, not just the code

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You care about quality. You write clean, testable code. You review your peers' work thoughtfully. You push for continuous improvement without gold-plating

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems — trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • Technical influence — direct input into architectural decisions, solution design, and the technical direction of the platform

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to lead roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

jobs.description:
A Little Bit About Us:

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share, and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world.

To do this, we have built the VarSome suite of bioinformatic tools, the world’s leading resource for analysis and interpretation of human genome variant data, with more than 6000 citations in scientific papers and over 60000 registered professional users. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories, analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes.

Saphetor is a Swiss precision medicine company with offices in Lausanne (CH), Boston (USA), and Athens (GR) employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a C++ Developer to join our backend team. If you're driven by clean code, cross team collaboration and excited to work in the fast moving world of genomics, this is a place where your work will matter.

We thrive in a high-pressure, high-performance environment where clinical precision and rapid growth meet. While our pace is fast, it is always directed by rigorous organization and clear processes, ensuring that our commitment to quality is never compromised by our drive for speed.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Code Craftsmanship: Write reusable, testable, and efficient code — backed by thorough unit and regression tests that keep the platform reliable as it evolves.
  • Core Engineering: Develop our core C++ applications and library for importing and analyzing genetic data.
  • Project Ownership: Take complete ownership of projects ranging from a few days to a month, delivering working end-to-end implementations from design through testing and deployment.
  • Performance & Scale: Assist in the optimization and architecture of our platform for maximum speed, high availability, and scalability — pushing the limits of what's possible with large-scale genomic data.
  • Annotation Tooling: Maintain and improve our internal high-performance clinical annotation tools and the custom databases purpose-built and optimized for genetics workloads.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to clear, lasting documentation of software architecture and implementation details so the team can build on.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with backend engineers, bioinformaticians, and product stakeholders to scope work, align on interfaces, and deliver cohesive end-to-end features.

The Ideal Candidate (Profile)

The ideal candidate is a C++ Developer with hands-on experience writing modern C++. You write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable engaging in code reviews and cross-functional work with other stakeholders.

What you will bring:

  • Academic Foundation: BS or MS degree in Computer Science.
  • C++ Expertise: At least 3 years of professional experience as a back-end developer working with C++ (preferably with C++ 17 or later), templates, STL containers, smart pointers, memory management and multithreading.
  • Database Skills: Hands-on experience with relational databases, including optimizing queries and table schemas for peak performance.
  • Distributed Systems: Solid experience with distributed cloud-based computing and big-data systems.
  • Design Principles: Good grasp of fundamental application design and object-oriented principles, essential for building and maintaining a large, high-quality codebase.
  • Active Engagement: Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Team Player: Flexible mindset, comfortable stepping into a variety of roles as needed.

Strongly Valued:

  • In-Memory & RPC Tech: Experience with in-memory databases like Redis and gRPC services.
  • Domain Interest: Some bioinformatics background — or a genuine willingness to dive into the domain.

While our foundation is in Athens, our talent pool is spread across Europe, with a strong culture of remote collaboration. Our team is highly experienced in distributed Agile workflows and communicates exclusively in fluent English.

Your career journey with us includes, among others:

  • A position in a fascinating healthcare growth domain, at the cutting edge of technology and research
  • A competitive compensation package tailored to your unique expertise and professional background.
  • A remote-first work environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance
  • Endless learning opportunities, while transferring new technologies from academics to clinical practice all over the world.

Saphetor is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and our employees, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, medical condition or disability, sexual orientation, gender expression, or marital status.

Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer to design, deploy, and operate large-scale, secure, and resilient cloud platforms on Microsoft Azure. In this role you will own the end-to-end cloud engineering lifecycle, including architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security hardening, cost optimization, observability, and ongoing operational excellence for production workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across Azure services with strong DevOps engineering practices, and will partner closely with application development, security, and SRE teams to deliver cloud-native solutions that meet demanding business requirements for scalability, reliability, and compliance.

  • Mentor junior engineers, lead architecture reviews, and contribute actively to internal communities of practice around Azure and DevOps.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on Microsoft Azure in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure core services, including compute, storage, networking, identity, and platform-as-a-service offerings.
  • Production-level experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Solid experience designing and operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for CI/CD across infrastructure and applications.
  • Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, and Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation code.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security principles, identity management, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies across distributed workloads.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.

jobs.description:
Job Description

CelebriOS is a software company building B2B SaaS products that help businesses make better decisions, streamline operations, and get more value from their data. Our products combine practical business workflows with intuitive technology designed for everyday use.

You will join the engineering team behind our new mid-market analytics platform, building the interface customers rely on to explore data, understand performance, and turn complex information into actionable insights. You will work closely with product, design, and backend engineering to create a fast, accessible, and consistent experience as the platform grows.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and maintain the customer-facing application using React and TypeScript

  • Create intuitive dashboards, data exploration experiences, and interactive visualization components

  • Help evolve CelebriOS's shared component library in close collaboration with product design

  • Own frontend performance for views that work with large and complex datasets

  • Build accessible interfaces that meet WCAG AA standards and continuously improve the user experience

  • Work with backend engineers to shape APIs and data structures around real product requirements

  • Contribute to frontend architecture and technical decisions as the product and engineering team evolve

  • Review code, share knowledge, and contribute to a strong frontend engineering culture

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years of professional experience building production frontends with React and TypeScript

  • Strong understanding of component architecture, state management, and modern frontend patterns

  • Hands-on experience building accessible web applications

  • Experience working with data-heavy or complex user interfaces

  • Ability to explain the technical and product decisions behind work you have built

  • Comfortable collaborating closely with designers and giving and receiving constructive feedback

  • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the overall user experience

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with data-visualization libraries such as D3 or Recharts

  • Experience contributing to or building a design system

  • Frontend performance profiling and optimization

  • Figma fluency

  • Experience building analytics, reporting, or B2B SaaS products

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

$95,000-$125,000 determined based on experience, technical expertise, and overall fit for the role.

CelebriOS offers a remote-first working environment, professional development opportunities, and a benefits package designed to support our team. Full details of compensation, benefits, and other employment terms will be discussed during the interview process.

HIRING PROCESS

Application review → introductory conversation → technical discussion → conversation with the team → offer.

We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with clear communication throughout the process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

CelebriOS is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

If you need an accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know and we will work with you to make the process accessible.

Location: Remote

Salary Range: 95,000 - 125,000 USD (gross, annually)

Job Title: Frontend Engineer

Job Type: Contract

Location: Remote

micro1 is selecting skilled Frontend Engineers to support a customer's innovative project. In this role, you'll apply your UI development expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your development skills are what matter.

As an expert, you will be creating Reinforcement Learning Environments which test an AI model's ability to solve frontend software problems related to fixing UI bugs, building interface features, and improving component code. You will be tasked with creating a reproducible environment and a golden reference solution for the problem.

Scope of Work

  1. Contribute clear code samples, debugging approaches, and development insights in JavaScript, TypeScript, and a modern framework (React, Vue, or Angular).
  2. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve UI bugs, layout issues, and state-related problems across different codebases.
  3. Build small to medium interface features, keeping components clean, reusable, and easy to follow.
  4. Improve existing frontend code for better readability, performance, and consistency.
  5. Document your reasoning, approach, and code decisions to support AI training data quality.
  6. Review peer-contributed code and technical submissions for correctness and clarity.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. 1+ years of hands-on experience building user interfaces with JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework.
  2. Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive design, and component-based architecture.
  3. Ability to debug UI issues using browser dev tools and reason through state and rendering behavior.
  4. Comfortable working across different codebases and picking up unfamiliar components.
  5. Good documentation and communication skills to explain your technical decisions clearly.
  6. Interest in or curiosity about AI and its technical challenges (previous AI experience not required).

About the role

You will be a senior contributor to our frontend product experience, working across our product suite, including our self-custodial wallet interfaces, account abstraction user flows, and a growing set of web and mobile decentralized applications (dApps). As a senior frontend engineer on the team, you will help shape frontend architecture, deliver complex user-facing features, and embed performance, reliability, and usability best practices into every release.

You will work closely with designers, product managers, and engineers to take features from concept to production, while contributing to improving code quality, system design, and team workflows.

Key responsibilities

Frontend architecture & technical contributions: Contribute to the evolution of frontend system design, patterns, and best practices.

Application development: Design, build, and maintain complex, production-grade frontend applications using TypeScript and TanStack Start.

State management & data orchestration: Implement and maintain scalable client-side state using Zustand and TanStack Query to ensure predictable and performant data flows.

Project ownership: Own and deliver end-to-end frontend workstreams, including:

  • Core wallet and account abstraction UX flows
  • High-throughput, data-rich product interfaces
  • New web and mobile dApp surfaces

Testing & reliability: Contribute to and maintain Playwright-based end-to-end test suites to improve coverage and release confidence.

Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Product, Design, and Backend teams to refine requirements and deliver high-quality outcomes.

Qualifications

Required experience

  • 2 ~ 4 years of experience as a frontend engineer
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript.
  • Experience with TanStack Start or comparable meta-frameworks (e.g., Next.js, Remix).
  • Solid expertise in modern React patterns, performance optimization, and frontend application design.
  • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate development.
  • Background in web3, blockchain, or decentralized application development.
  • Experience in startup or scale-up environments.

Location and logistics

  • East Asia preferred (Tokyo, Singapore, HongKong)

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Duo CLI functional team, part of the Developer Clients group within GitLab's AI Clients stage, you'll design and build tools that bring GitLab Duo into developers' daily terminal workflows. You'll shape AI-assisted experiences across GitLab Duo CLI and its supporting infrastructure, working mainly in TypeScript across the frontend and backend and making key architectural decisions about the CLI's future direction. You'll also have opportunities to contribute across Developer Clients, including our JetBrains plugin in Kotlin and our VS Code extension in TypeScript, when shared features, components, or cross-platform consistency call for it.

You'll provide technical leadership by breaking down complex problems, aligning on long-term direction, and maintaining a high bar for code quality, performance, and reliability. You'll collaborate closely with engineers across Developer Clients and the wider AI Clients stage, including the Duo Client SDK and Duo Chat groups, to make GitLab Duo fast, intuitive, and deeply integrated wherever developers work.

Some examples of our projects:

  • Duo CLI
  • GitLab Language Server
  • GitLab Duo plugin for JetBrains IDEs
  • GitLab Duo extension for VS Code

What you’ll do

  • Own the design, development, and evolution of GitLab Duo CLI features from problem definition with Product through implementation, rollout, and iteration, measuring success through feature usage and feedback.
  • Build interactive terminal experiences in TypeScript, with careful command and flag design, clear output formatting, scripting-friendly behavior, and backward compatibility.
  • Drive reliability, observability, and performance improvements for the CLI, measuring progress through reliability and performance metrics while reducing technical debt as the product and its usage grow.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and engineers across Developer Clients and the wider AI Clients stage to align technical decisions with GitLab's broader strategy.
  • Champion product quality, security, and developer experience through thoughtful reviews and mentorship.
  • Contribute to IDE extension work across the group when useful, including the JetBrains plugin in Kotlin and the VS Code extension in TypeScript.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and an interest in developer tooling and command-line interface design.
  • Experience building or maintaining command-line tools or other developer-facing tooling, including command and flag design, terminal user interfaces, output formatting, scripting-friendly behavior, and backward compatibility.
  • Experience owning technical problems end to end, making sound architectural trade-offs, and guiding other engineers through code reviews and mentorship.
  • Clear written and spoken English communication skills and comfort working in a fully remote, largely asynchronous environment.
  • Alignment with GitLab's values and commitment to an inclusive culture.
  • Experience with IDE extension development, such as JetBrains plugins in Kotlin or VS Code extensions, and understanding of the Language Server Protocol (LSP), language servers, or editor integrations are helpful but not required.

About the team

Our broader Developer Clients group includes the VS Code and JetBrains functional teams. We hold a weekly sync and encourage engineers to collaborate across team boundaries when it benefits the shared developer experience. We're fully remote and work largely asynchronously, partnering closely with Product, Design, and engineering teams across AI Clients to align on long-term architecture and deliver iterative improvements.

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Overview

Lynker Corporation is a leading provider of innovative solutions in weather and climate science. With a commitment to excellence and a passion for innovation, Lynker leverages cutting-edge technologies and scientific expertise to support the creation and delivery of improved operational weather forecasts. As part of our ongoing growth and expansion, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced TypeScript Developer to join our growing team.

Responsibilities

Duties of the TypeScript Developer will include the following:

  • Front-end development: design and build user-facing web applications in TypeScript that highlight, share, and integrate spatial data.
  • Spatial data visualization: build interactive maps and views that make complex geospatial data understandable and usable.
  • Reusable foundations: develop reusable components and patterns that carry across current and future front-end applications.
  • Integration: work with the API and data teams to connect applications to live data and services.
  • Collaboration & quality: collaborate across the Science, Engineering, Platform, and Applications teams, writing tested, maintainable, and reproducible code and clear documentation

Qualifications

The TypeScript Developer selected should have the following:

  • Master's or Bachelor's in computer science, software engineering, GIS, or a related field; or equivalent hands-on experience in place of a degree.
  • Strong front-end development skills in TypeScript and a modern framework such as React.
  • Experience building interactive, data-rich web interfaces.
  • Comfort connecting applications to REST/JSON APIs and working with structured data.
  • Comfort with Git and modern web build and deployment tooling.

The Ideal TypeScript Developer will have the following:

  • Project coordination or technical project-management experience (e.g., Agile workflows, roadmap and backlog, cross-team delivery).
  • Experience with web mapping libraries (e.g., MapLibre GL, Leaflet, or deck.gl) and tile formats such as PMTiles or vector tiles.

Radity is a global software engineering company delivering innovative digital solutions to clients around the world. We are passionate about building great technology and fostering a collaborative environment where people grow, take ownership, and make a real impact.

Job Description

We are looking for a TypeScript Software Engineer to join our growing engineering team. You will work on modern web applications, backend services, and cloud-based solutions for international clients across various industries.

Whether your experience is primarily in frontend, backend, or full-stack development, this role offers the opportunity to build scalable applications, collaborate with experienced engineers, and contribute to high-quality software throughout the development lifecycle.

Your Role

In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain applications using TypeScript and modern development frameworks. Depending on the project, your work may involve frontend development, backend APIs, or full-stack solutions.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving technical challenges, writing clean and maintainable code, and taking ownership of their work while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable applications using TypeScript
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
  • Develop backend services and REST APIs using Node.js and related technologies
  • Design and integrate APIs with internal and external systems
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance
  • Use AI tools to support analysis, development, and engineering productivity

Requirements

  • Professional experience with TypeScript development
  • Experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks and ecosystems
  • Experience with frontend, backend, or full-stack application development
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and modern web architectures
  • Understanding of software engineering best practices, testing, and version control
  • English proficiency: minimum B2, ideally C1
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

What's In It for You

  • Work on modern software projects for international clients
  • Opportunity to contribute across frontend, backend, or full-stack development
  • Exposure to cloud technologies, scalable architectures, and modern engineering practices
  • Collaborative, remote-first working environment
  • Ownership and impact on end-to-end software solutions
  • Support for learning and professional growth

We are seeking an experienced AWS Principal Software Engineer to join our AWS practice Managed Service's team. This is a fully remote opportunity based in the Philippines.

As a technical member of the Managed Services team, you will maintain the AWS Practice’s designed solution for our clients. Maintaining the production systems will involve identifying and addressing issues the client is experiencing, building, testing, and deploying those changes to the client's system. AWS Engineers will work to refine the process of delivering projects by building internal tools, suggesting new methods for designing and building systems, and providing feedback to clients on issues they are experiencing.
This is a permanent, fully remote position based in the Philippines. Candidates must be willing to work US business hours to support our global clients and operations.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Daily meetings with the internal team

  • Weekly meetings with clients and TTEC Digital client account managers

  • Requirements analysis and design conversations when you have a new enhancement to build.

  • Working on issues in Jira with your team - building systems, creating CloudFormation/Serverless templates to deploy resources, etc.

  • Learning best practices used in the NodeJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python communities

  • Working with your mentor/team lead to further knowledge of AWS Services, tools, or even new languages to address client issues

  • Learning new ways of doing things and sharing new learnings with internal team members

  • You need to be ready to learn quickly!

What You Bring to the Role

  • Advanced knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture

  • 5+ years’ development experience with 3+ years of development experience with a focus on TypeScript/, working with AWS services

  • Functional knowledge of agile methodologies such as Scrum

  • The ideal candidate seeks to understand before prescribing a solution.

  • A love for technology and the latest and greatest in development best practices, especially the latest services from AWS

About Us

TTEC Digital and our 1,800+ employees, pioneer engagement and growth solutions that fuel the exceptional customer experience (CX). Our sister company, TTEC Engage, is a 60,000+ employee service company, with customer service representatives located around the world. TTEC Holdings Inc. is the parent company for both Digital and Engage. When clients have a holistic need, they can draw from these independently managed centers of excellence, TTEC Digital and TTEC Engage.
We are also delighted to share that TTEC has been awarded the Great Place To Work 2024-2025 certification based on outstanding employee experience across 14 countries.
TTEC is a proud equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability. TTEC has fully embraced and is committed to expanding our diverse and inclusive workforce. We strive to reflect the communities we serve while delivering amazing service and technology centered around humanity.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Hello!  We're Teya. Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe.
jobs.description:
Hello! We're Teya.

Teya is a payment and software service provider, headquartered in London serving small, local businesses across Europe. Founded in 2019, we build easy to use, integrated tools that enable our members to accept payments and boost business performance.

At Teya we believe small, local businesses are the lifeblood of our communities.

We’re here because we don’t believe there’s a level playing field that gives small businesses with a fighting chance against the giants of the high street.

We’re here because we see banks and legacy service providers making things harder for them. We don’t think the best technology or the best service should be reserved for those with the biggest headquarters.

We’re here to fight for a future where small, local businesses can thrive, and to commit the same dedication they offer all of us.

Become a part of our story.

We’re looking for exceptional talent to join our mission. We offer a chance to create impact in a high-energy and connected culture, while benefiting from continuous learning opportunities, a supportive community which is proud to serve our mission, and comprehensive benefits.

Role description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our ePOS Integration team, with a specialised focus on building and scaling the frontend experience for our product and enhancing its supporting backend services:

In this pivotal role, you'll design, develop, and maintain the partner developer web portal that empowers our integration partners and third-party developers to manage accounts, spin up sandbox environments, complete integration certifications, access development support, and navigate our API documentation. As a full-stack engineer, you'll work across the frontend and contribute to the backend services that power the portal. Your work will directly shape how partners build on top of our platform, from their first sandbox call to production go-live.

You'll be joining an exciting remake of the product, meaning you'll have a foundational role in defining the web experience for partner developers from near the ground up. You'll translate complex integration and certification workflows into intuitive, secure, and high-performance developer interfaces, while supporting the backend services behind them, collaborating closely alongside product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, and platform teams. Your expertise will be instrumental in delivering a developer experience that makes integrating with us fast, clear, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable, responsive full stack features for the Business Account portal using React, TypeScript, and GraphQL, with ownership spanning both frontend implementation and integration with backend services.

  • Work closely with product and design teams to understand merchant needs and translate complex financial workflows—such as transfers, scheduled payments, account management, and Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) flows—into secure, end-to-end user experiences backed by reliable APIs.

  • Build and maintain data-rich, high-performance interfaces for transaction feeds, balances, statements, and multi-currency views, ensuring efficient data fetching, state management, and seamless interaction with backend services.

  • Develop and maintain GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and API integrations, ensuring consistency between frontend requirements and backend data models while promoting type safety and end-to-end reliability.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code across the stack, applying strong TypeScript practices and contributing to overall system stability, security, and scalability.

  • Actively participate in code reviews across frontend and backend contributions, helping establish engineering best practices in a team transitioning from a mobile-first to a full stack, web-capable organization.

  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, data inefficiencies, and production issues across the full stack, ensuring a smooth, reliable experience for merchant users.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest frontend technologies, trends, and best practices, applying them to enhance our merchant-facing web platform.

Your Story

  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend/web development.

  • Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type manipulation, generics, and understanding of complex type inference.

  • Strong proficiency in React.js and its core principles, developed with a type-safe approach.

  • Experience supporting Backend services in Java and Spring Boot

  • Extensive experience with Next.js for server-side rendering, static site generation, and API routes, with a focus on TypeScript integration.

  • Solid understanding of modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.

  • Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Context API, Zustand) in a TypeScript environment.

  • Strong experience consuming GraphQL APIs (e.g., Apollo Client), with an understanding of how to define and use types for API responses.

  • Strong understanding of web performance optimisation techniques.

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities, especially when working within cross-functional teams spanning product, design, backend, and mobile engineering.

Optional Tech Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Proficiency with UI component libraries such as Chakra UI or Material UI, with experience leveraging their TypeScript definitions.

  • Experience with RESTful API integration.

  • Familiarity with internationalisation (i18n) frameworks for multi-language, multi-market web applications.

Differentiators (What Sets You Apart)

  • Experience in fintech or banking web applications, including secure and compliant interfaces with SCA/2FA, PSD2, and RBAC

  • Proven ability to build and translate mobile-first products into responsive web experiences

  • Practical use of AI coding tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality

  • Experience launching and localising web products across multiple European markets, including currency, regulatory, and language requirements

Teya is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, stronger outcomes, and a more supportive workplace for all.

If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process whether for interviews, assessments, or other parts of the application—we encourage you to let us know. We are committed to ensuring that every candidate has a fair and accessible experience with us.
